claims.claim_text: Quy mô doanh thu thị trường game Đông Nam Á năm 2025 dự kiến đạt 5,47 tỷ USD.
claims.quote: The region’s market is expected to grow 1.8% in 2025 to $5.47 billion.
claims.verify_note: Đã tìm thấy câu trích trong nguồn
claims.context:
rated $5.37 billion in games revenue in 2024, up 5.2% year-over-year (YoY).
Revenue is expected to continue growing in 2025, albeit at a slower growth rate than in years past. The slower growth is due to current economic and political issues faced by some of the countries in the region, although Niko projects the growth to rebound in the coming years.
There are also slight declines in Indonesia and the Philippines driven by economic woes, as seen in the multiple protests taking place in both countries this year. There are many more details disclosed in the Market Model reports.
Key highlights
The region’s market is expected to grow 1.8% in 2025 to $5.47 billion. The market is forecasted to reach $6.47 billion in 2029 at a 5-year CAGR of 3.8%.

Revenue, audience, monetization

reasons.text: Quy mô doanh thu thị trường game Đông Nam Á năm 2025 dự kiến đạt 5,47 tỷ USD theo ước tính của Niko Partners, nhưng đây là số dự báo và chưa được đối chiếu bản gốc.
